copy.title: Deepin Harness · Enterprise AI runtime
copy.description: Deepin Harness is the enterprise runtime underneath every Deepin Investigation and Space. It gives agents roles, authority, capabilities, knowledge, policies and controls, so AI can work inside an organization.
copy.hero_lede: Deepin Harness is the runtime underneath every Deepin Investigation and Space. It gives agents the roles, capabilities, knowledge, policies and controls they need to work inside an enterprise.
copy.hero_line: Models reason. Capabilities act. Policies govern. Harness orchestrates.
copy.problem_lede: A model with a few tools can already do useful work. The hard part starts when that agent has to work inside a company.
copy.problem_simple_cap: An agent can reason and call tools.
copy.problem_q: What an enterprise asks around it
copy.model_h2: Give AI a place in the organization.
copy.model_lede: An enterprise agent should not be an anonymous model with tools. In Deepin Harness it works inside an explicit organizational context: what it is responsible for, what it may do, and under which rules.
copy.rsn_lede: Roles define responsibility. Authority defines delegation and decision rights. Capabilities define what can be done. Policies define the boundaries.
copy.rt_lede: Work enters the Harness, runs under organizational context and governance, and leaves an auditable trace.
copy.rt_quote: Models reason. Capabilities act. Policies govern. Harness orchestrates.
copy.rt_side: A model call answers a prompt. Governed work knows who asked, in which role, with which capability, under which policy, and who approved it.
copy.cl_lede: Real Investigations are shared work. Roles delegate, build on shared evidence and hand the decision to a person.
copy.gv_lede: Enterprise AI should be able to act. Every action still passes through role, authority, policy and constraints, and ends in one of three outcomes.
copy.gv_note: Controls are configured for each deployment, to the organization's own rules.
copy.km_lede: Work should not start from zero every time. What the organization knows, and what it learned in earlier Investigations, is available to the roles doing the work.
copy.ev_h2: Every action leaves evidence. Every behavior can be evaluated.
copy.ev_lede: Models change. Prompts change. Tools change. Knowledge and policies change. So enterprise AI needs evaluation that keeps running, not a test at launch.
copy.ob_lede: Every step of an Investigation is recorded with who acted, in which role, with which capability, on which source and under which policy. It is the same principle as the rest of Deepin: evidence before decision.
copy.sp_lede: A Space packages reusable roles, capabilities, data sources, knowledge, policies, evaluations and Investigations for a business domain.
copy.pf_lede: Harness capabilities are being shaped by concrete enterprise Investigations, not in an isolated framework experiment. Each reference is shown at the maturity it has actually reached.
copy.rs_lede: Deepin Harness is continuously developed through R&D in organizational reasoning, governed agent collaboration, constraint-aware planning and continuous evaluation.
copy.band_h2: Build AI that can work inside your organization.
copy.band_p: Start from a real Investigation, or use Deepin Harness to bring governed AI into an existing enterprise workflow.
copy.band_next: Don't deploy another agent. Build an organization.

hero_org.title: Deepin Harness · runtime
hero_org.aria: Deepin Harness runtime: an organization gives roles to agents; agents use capabilities, knowledge and policies to complete a task, which goes to human approval before action.

questions: What is it allowed to do?
Who can delegate work to it?

model.aria: Conceptual organization model of Deepin Harness
org: The boundary in which roles, authority, knowledge, policies and capabilities exist.

auth: Who may decide, approve, delegate or act?
pol: Under what conditions may this happen?
agent: Does the work, within its role.
tool: A technical way a capability gets done.
API · MCP tool · query · model · function
svc: Internal or external systems exposed to the organization.
ERP · CRM · core banking · registry service · document system
know: Organizational information available to roles and agents.
Documents · graphs · structured data · previous Investigations · organizational memory

model.note: A conceptual model, not a class diagram. Capability ≠ Tool: a capability is what can be done; a tool is one technical way to do it. Authority ≠ Policy: authority is who may decide, approve, delegate or act; policy is the rules under which it happens.

pair: Structure and state: who exists, what they are responsible for, what they may do.
Behavior over time: how the organization works out who should do what when something happens.
reasoning.loop: and again, with the next event
reasoning.note: This is more than routing prompts between agents: each step is answered against the organization's own roles, authority and rules.

concepts: Each role owns part of the work.
The lead hands work to roles with the authority and capability for it.

examples.label: Read the latest registry filing
examples.why: Within the role, the authority and the monitoring policy. It runs, and the step is logged.

examples.label: Raise the supplier's risk level
examples.why: Changing a risk level is a decision. The agent proposes it with the evidence; a person approves.

examples.label: Send the company file to an outside party
examples.why: Policy does not allow case files to leave the organization. The request is denied and recorded.

knowledge.loop: Every Investigation can contribute reusable organizational context.
knowledge.data_p: This knowledge lives in your deployment and belongs to you. It is not shared between customers. What carries from one deployment to the next is how Investigations are solved, never your records.
knowledge.aria: Knowledge sources flow into organizational knowledge, which roles, agents and Investigations use

criteria: Did it stay inside the rules?
evaluation.note: Evaluation informs improvement. The system does not change itself silently; people review changes and release them.
